title: Rue Morgue
summary: A resident of a retirement home is found dead from sleeping pills. It's made to look like a suicide.
method: The killer put sleeping pills in her own meal and swapped it with the victim's. They then retrieved the plate with the poisoned food on it and broke the lock to make it look like a locked room.
motive: The killer was jealous that the victim seemingly stole her boyfriend.
killer: One of the other retirement home residents; a friend of the victim
notes:
DI Goodman's ex-wife visits the island and wants to reconcile. DI Goodman dumps her and admits to Fidel at the end that he loves Camille.
This is Fidel's last episode. It's clear that the writers didn't know what to do with his character. Besides the episode where his friend is murdered and he's angry for no reason the entire episode, there are other episodes where he just randomly gets mad at Dwayne for not following procedure.
